body: Right-click a Beacon to claim it as a Field Office; right-click someone else's to open a 60s Contest Window (flips to the challenger if within 15 blocks on resolution). Flow ticks +5/min per held FO; /flow shows balance. Claim/flip events post as IDUNA Apples via the emily CLI. Built, deployed to the live EINHORN_SURVIVAL server, confirmed enabling cleanly in server.log. Gameplay itself not yet live-tested by a real connected client -- needs founder playtest before VS0 is considered fully proven.
title: VS0 — Field Office claim/Contest Window/Flow loop live
